thread.title: Dow pares gains, with Microsoft and Apple weighing - MarketWatch

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: Dow pares gains, with Microsoft and Apple weighing - MarketWatch
text:
Published: Mar 27, 2018 2:12 p.m. ET Share Ryan Vlastelica Markets reporter 
The Dow Jones Industrial Average briefly turned negative in afternoon trading on Tuesday, with the blue-chip average pressured by weakness in large-capitalization technology stocks. The Dow DJIA, -1.43% was flat at 24,202; previously, it rose as high as 24,446.22. The biggest drags on the Dow were Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -4.60% which fell 2.1%, and Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.56% down 1.1%. Both stocks retreated following sharp rallies in the previous session. Apple climbed 4.8% on Monday while Microsoft surged 7.6% in its biggest one-day jump since October 2015 . The S&P 500 SPX, -1.73% fell 0.3% while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -2.93% fell 1.3%, pressured by the weakness in tech . Quote References
